protocolStatement: Append-only QA of all 34 committed eventLabels (18 wave-a via event-bounds-wave-a.json + 16 v1 labels in bundle annotations). No source annotation file was modified; corrections are filed here only. Every event was re-viewed as rendered frame sheets at eventStartMs, contactMs-1frame, contactMs, contactMs+1frame, eventEndMs (frame step per source fps), with extra fine scrubs and zoom crops where the first pass was inconclusive. Source media: committed bundle clips where present (afn-sasebo-rally1, wm-dink-01, wm-volley-02) plus provenance-verified downloads (dhash-per-second match against datasets/corpus/fingerprints/) for all other recordings. HELD-OUT discipline: wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were reviewed as observation-only; no threshold, label, or pipeline iteration was performed against them.

verdictKey.PASS_VERIFIED: ball seen at/adjacent to the striker's paddle at contactMs +-1 frame, or the label's stated evidence convention (ball reversal / interpolation) directly reproduced
verdictKey.PASS_CONSISTENT: contact frame itself occluded or below resolvable size, but ball trajectory + body kinematics across bracketing frames are consistent with the labeled bounds; no contradicting evidence
verdictKey.FLAG: visual evidence contradicts the label or its evidence basis; correction filed

corrections.detail: The committed clip (and the source at ~29.85s) has a hard camera cut between clip-times 3837 and 3850. contactMs 3870 and eventEndMs 4300 fall after the cut in a different camera view, so the v1 'contact from ball turn' evidence is invalid. Recommended disposition for the corpus owner: either truncate the event at the cut (drop contactMs, endMs<=3837, contact evidence 'occluded/none') or drop the event; additionally fix the recordings.json rec-21fb75446a03 'Single continuous shot' derivation note. Filed append-only; source annotation NOT edited.
